title: Allergy-Free Day Streak
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allergy:entry
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(symptom_free="true")) as successful by _time trigger_season
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for symptom-free allergy days by season.
value: Symptom-free streaks make progress visible during seasons that otherwise feel uniformly bad.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for symptom-free allergy days events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for symptom-free allergy days by season.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often symptom-free allergy days works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
